title: Prosecution for Hirers of Bicycles Who Damage Bicycles Illegally
what_it_is: Prosecution for Hirers of Bicycles Who Damage Bicycles Illegally

sections.label: Police investigation of rental bicycle cases
sections.summary: Police investigate reported criminal offences, consult the Attorney-General's Chambers on prosecution, and cite two rental bicycle cases.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Home Affairs (Mr Amrin Amin) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: The Police will conduct an investigation if a case is reported and a criminal offence is committed.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Home Affairs (Mr Amrin Amin) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: Based on the facts of the case, the Police will consult the Attorney-General's Chambers, who will decide whether to prosecute the persons involved, whether the offender is a hirer or not.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Home Affairs (Mr Amrin Amin) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: For example, last month, the Police investigated two cases at Jalan Tenteram and Upper Boon Keng, where rental bicycles were thrown from buildings.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Home Affairs (Mr Amrin Amin) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: The person arrested for the Upper Boon Keng case was charged in Court and he was convicted of a rash act and sentenced to nine weeks' jail.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Home Affairs (Mr Amrin Amin) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: For the Jalan Tenteram case, an arrest was also made and investigations are ongoing.

sections.label: Theft and conversion enforcement action
sections.summary: The issue is treated as theft and conversion, with enforcement action and punitive action where necessary.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lim Biow Chuan (Mountbatten)
sentences.text: To me, this is theft, this is conversion.

sentences.speaker: Mr Amrin Amin
sentences.text: It is an issue that we take seriously and we will work closely with the Ministry of Transport to conduct enforcement action.

sentences.speaker: Mr Amrin Amin
sentences.text: Where necessary, we will take punitive action to deter such acts.
